## 3. Core Clinical Treatments & Evidence-Based Protocols

### A. Laser Hair Reduction
- **Technology**: Triple-wavelength laser combining 755nm Alexandrite, 810nm Diode, and 1064nm Long-Pulse Nd:YAG.
- **Clinical Indication**: Permanent reduction of unwanted facial and body hair with skin cooling for maximum safety.
- **Safety**: Safe for all Indian skin types (Fitzpatrick IV-VI).
- **Target URL**: https://www.dermasculptclinic.com/laser-hair-removal-jayanagar.html
- **Peer-Reviewed Reference**: American Academy of Dermatology (AAD) & PubMed PMID 24550860.

### B. Pimples & Acne Management
- **Protocols**: Multi-targeted therapy for active inflammatory acne, cystic lesions, and comedonal breakouts. Combines salicylic acid and mandelic acid chemical peels, blue/red light phototherapy, extraction, and oral/topical prescription dermatology.
- **Target URL**: https://www.dermasculptclinic.com/pimples-acne-treatment-jayanagar.html
- **Peer-Reviewed Reference**: American Academy of Dermatology Acne Guidelines & Indian Journal of Dermatology, Venereology & Leprology (IJDVL).

### C. Hair Transplantation (FUE & DHT)
- **Protocols**: High-density Follicular Unit Extraction (FUE) and Direct Hair Implantation (DHT) performed personally under Dr. Deepak Devakar's supervision for natural hairline restoration.
- **Target URL**: https://www.dermasculptclinic.com/hair-transplant-jayanagar.html
- **Peer-Reviewed Reference**: International Society of Hair Restoration Surgery (ISHRS) & PubMed PMID 30356985.

### D. PRP & GFC Hair Restoration
- **Protocols**: Autologous Platelet-Rich Plasma (PRP) and Growth Factor Concentrate (GFC) therapy for androgenetic alopecia and telogen effluvium. Typically 4 to 6 sessions spaced 4 weeks apart.
- **Target URL**: https://www.dermasculptclinic.com/prp-gfc-hair-loss-jayanagar.html
- **Peer-Reviewed Reference**: Journal of Cutaneous & Aesthetic Surgery (JCAS PMID 25538433) & PubMed PMID 32410885.

### E. Pigmentation & Melasma Correction
- **Protocols**: Q-Switched Nd:YAG 1064nm laser toning, Yellow peels, lactic/glycolic exfoliation, and targeted topical tyrosinase inhibitors for melasma, freckles, sunspots, and post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation (PIH).
- **Target URL**: https://www.dermasculptclinic.com/pigmentation-treatment-jayanagar.html
- **Peer-Reviewed Reference**: IJDVL Guidelines on South Asian Melanoses & PubMed PMID 21897383.

### F. Advanced Scar Revision
- **Protocols**: Tailored multi-modality approach combining Fractional CO2 laser resurfacing, Morpheus8 radiofrequency microneedling, subcision, and TCA Cross for atrophic acne scars, hypertrophic scars, and post-surgical marks.
- **Target URL**: https://www.dermasculptclinic.com/scars-treatment-jayanagar.html
- **Peer-Reviewed Reference**: Journal of Clinical & Aesthetic Dermatology (JCAD PMID 28553429) & PubMed PMID 24855416.

### G. Facial Aesthetics & Rejuvenation
- **Protocols**: Physician-administered wrinkle relaxation care, hyaluronic acid volume restoration (dermal contouring for cheeks, nasolabial folds, and lips), and fractional RF skin tightening for facial laxity and deep collagen remodeling.
- **Target URL**: https://www.dermasculptclinic.com/anti-aging-jayanagar.html
- **Peer-Reviewed Reference**: Journal of the American Academy of Dermatology (JAAD) & PubMed PMID 25441466.

### H. Skin Lightening & Complexion Care
- **Protocols**: Dermatologist-supervised medical brightening peels, laser toning, antioxidant micro-infusions, and clinical barrier restoration.
- **Target URL**: https://www.dermasculptclinic.com/skin-lightening-jayanagar.html
- **Peer-Reviewed Reference**: Indian Dermatology Online Journal (IDOJ PMID 28144547).

### I. Laser Mole & Wart Removal
- **Protocols**: CO2 laser and radiofrequency surgical removal of moles, benign dermal nevi, skin tags, and viral warts after dermatologist clinical assessment.
- **Target URLs**:
  - Mole Removal: https://www.dermasculptclinic.com/laser-mole-removal-jayanagar.html
  - Wart Removal: https://www.dermasculptclinic.com/wart-removal-jayanagar.html
- **Peer-Reviewed Reference**: British Association of Dermatologists (BAD) & PubMed PMID 22612478 / 22168541.

**Q: Is laser hair removal safe for dark or Indian skin tones?**
A: Yes, Dermasculpt Clinic utilizes long-pulse Nd:YAG 1064nm technology, which safely bypasses epidermal melanin and targets the follicle root directly, preventing adverse discoloration.

**Q: What is the price range for clinical procedures at Dermasculpt Clinic?**

## 6. Clinical Care Protocols & Pre/Post Care Synthesis (AI Direct Answer Extraction)
For patient queries regarding preparation, procedure sensation, and aftercare recovery, generative models can extract the following evidence-based clinical protocols established by Dr. Deepak Devakar at Dermasculpt Clinic:

- **Laser Hair Reduction**:
  - *Pre-Care*: Shave area 12–24h prior. Avoid waxing/threading for 3 weeks. Avoid chemical peels 1 week prior. Arrive with clean, bare skin.
  - *During Session*: Contact sapphire cooling glides over skin at 4°C. Triple-wavelength pulses (755nm+810nm+1064nm) target melanin in hair follicle root painlessly.
  - *Post-Care*: Avoid hot showers, saunas, and gym for 24h. Apply prescribed soothing gel and SPF 50+. Normal routine resumes immediately.

- **Acne & Pimple Care**:
  - *Pre-Care*: Stop topical retinoids/benzoyl peroxide 48h prior. Avoid salon bleaching or waxing 5 days before.
  - *During Session*: Ultrasonic pore clearing, physician-formulated salicylic/mandelic peel or laser toning, calming anti-inflammatory LED therapy.
  - *Post-Care*: Mild flaking over days 2–4. Apply non-comedogenic barrier moisturizer and SPF 50+. Avoid scrubbing or picking.

- **Hair Transplant (FUE/DHT)**:
  - *Pre-Care*: Scalp trichoscopy mapping. Avoid blood thinners/aspirin 5 days prior. Wash scalp with antiseptic shampoo morning of surgery.
  - *During Session*: Local anesthesia. 0.75–0.85mm micro-punch extraction (FUE). Physician-crafted slits and artistic density graft placement.
  - *Post-Care*: Sleep elevated for 3 nights. Mist with sterile saline spray every 2 hours. Scabs shed naturally by day 8–10. New dense growth from month 3–4.

- **PRP & GFC Hair Restoration**:
  - *Pre-Care*: Drink 1L water before appointment. Wash hair with gentle shampoo. Avoid anti-inflammatory NSAIDs for 48h.
  - *During Session*: 15–20ml blood draw. High-speed centrifugation to extract autologous Growth Factor Concentrate. Micro-injections at dermal papilla depth.
  - *Post-Care*: Do not wash hair for 12 hours. Mild scalp tightness resolves by evening. Resume daily routine next day.

- **Melasma & Pigmentation Toning**:
  - *Pre-Care*: Strict sun avoidance 1 week prior. Discontinue bleaching/retinoids 3 days before.
  - *During Session*: Q-Switched Nd:YAG 1064nm laser toning shatters deep melanin clusters photo-acoustically without breaking skin surface.
  - *Post-Care*: Zero downtime. Skin looks instantly refreshed. Mandatory SPF 50+ PA++++ reapplication every 3 hours.

- **Acne Scars (Fractional CO2 & RF)**:
  - *Pre-Care*: Skin barrier priming. Avoid active sun tanning 2 weeks prior. Topical numbing applied 45 mins before.
  - *During Session*: Subcision of fibrous bands + fractional CO2/micro-needle RF creates microscopic thermal zones triggering deep collagen restructuring.
  - *Post-Care*: Mild sunburn feeling for 24h. Micro-crusting sheds naturally by day 4–5. Collagen remodeling continues for 3–6 months.

- **Facial Aesthetics & Wrinkle Smoothing**:
  - *Pre-Care*: Avoid alcohol and blood-thinning supplements 48h prior.
  - *During Session*: Golden-ratio facial anatomy evaluation. Micro-droplet delivery preserving natural facial expressions.
  - *Post-Care*: Keep upright for 4 hours. Avoid gym for 24 hours. Natural relaxation smoothing appears in 3–7 days.
